'''Carmen Batanero''' is a Spanish [[statistics education|statistics educator]], and a Senior Lecturer in the Mathematics Department at the [[University of Granada]], [[Spain]].<ref>{{cite web| title=University of Granada Staff| url=https://www.ugr.es/~batanero/index.html}}</ref> She is known as an advocate for statistics education.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Jiménez|first=Javier|date=2016-05-03|title=Por qué la estadística es la gran asignatura del siglo XXI|url=https://www.xataka.com/otros/por-que-la-estadistica-es-la-gran-asignatura-del-siglo-xxi|access-date=2021-12-28|website=Xataka|language=es}}</ref> Batanero is a lifetime member of the [[International Association for Statistical Education]], and served as the association's president from 2001 to 2003.<ref>{{cite web| title=IASE Executive Committee| url=http://iase-web.org/About.php?p=Executive_Committee}}</ref> She has co-authored many scholarly articles in the fields of mathematics and statistics education over the past two decades, and is credited on two statistics textbooks.<ref>{{cite web| title=ORCID Researcher Database| url=https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4189-7139}}</ref> Her contributions rank her as one of the most influential researchers at her institution.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2015-01-21|title=Los investigadores con más prestigio de la UGR|url=https://www.ideal.es/miugr/201501/21/investigadores-prestigio-20150120221057.html|access-date=2021-12-28|website=Ideal|language=es-ES}}</ref> Dr. Batanero obtained her doctorate from the [[University of Granada]] in 1983, with the thesis paper ''Modelos de choque y exposición intermitente a riesgo de fallo''.<ref>{{cite thesis| title=Fundación Dialnet: ''Modelos de choque y exposición intermitente a riesgo de fallo''| year=1983 | publisher=Universidad de Granada | url=https://dialnet.unirioja.es/servlet/tesis?codigo=13413}}</ref>
